title: Bank Deposit Principal Range, Real-Time Corridor Ceilings and Per-Recipient Frequency
content:
Each Bank Deposit tier sets the smallest and largest principal it accepts per transfer, any corridor ceiling imposed by the corridor's instant-payment scheme, and the largest number of Bank Deposit transfers to one recipient in a rolling 24 hours. All amounts are principal in US dollars.

## Schedule

| Tier | Smallest principal | Largest principal (before the account level's per-transfer limit) | Real-time corridor ceilings | Transfers to one recipient in a rolling 24 hours |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 10.00 | 10000.00 | none (not a real-time tier) | 3 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 10.00 | 10000.00 | none (not a real-time tier) | 3 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 10.00 | 2999.00 | PH-PHP 850.00; BD-BDT 2450.00; GH-GHS 1900.00 | 5 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | 50.00 | 6000.00 | PH-PHP 850.00; BD-BDT 2450.00; GH-GHS 1900.00 | 5 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 5000.00 | 75000.00 | none (not a real-time tier) | 2 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 100.00 | 50000.00 | none (not a real-time tier) | 2 |

## Terms

- The largest principal is the tier's own ceiling, applied before the per-transfer limit of the customer's Personal Sender Account level.
- A real-time corridor ceiling applies on the real-time tiers only. A corridor not listed for a real-time tier has no ceiling below that tier's largest principal; the non-real-time tiers carry no corridor ceiling at all.
- The per-recipient figure counts Bank Deposit transfers to the same recipient in a rolling 24 hours.

## Hypothetical readings

- On Bank Deposit Express, a principal of 900.00 to the Philippines (PH-PHP) is above the 850.00 ceiling; the same principal to Mexico (MX-MXN), a corridor with no listed ceiling, is bounded only by the tier's 2999.00.
- On Bank Deposit Express Plus, 50.00 is the smallest principal accepted, while on Bank Deposit Express it is 10.00.
- Bank Deposit Large Amount accepts no principal below 5000.00.
